The suite was not weakened; each case still constructs the bad state and confirms the control fires.

evidence.claim: The P5 validator was rewritten from bash to Python.
evidence.discrepancy: The bash implementation could not be made to parse. bash consumes a heredoc body before completing the surrounding list, so a heredoc placed directly in an if condition breaks the trailing else. Chained file appends also glued a fi onto the following sect line.
evidence.resolution: Reimplemented the validator in Python, removing heredoc and nesting hazards entirely. No check was dropped in the rewrite.
